results.title: ‎Energy Minister provides detailed information on cause of widespread nationwide power outage, says permanent Akosombo Control System was due next month
results.description: The Minister of Energy and Green Transition, Dr John Abdulai Jinapor, has provided detailed information on the cause of the widespread electric power outage in Ghana on Thursday morning, similar to what happened three weeks ago on Wednesday, July 29, 2026. Following the April 23, 2026 fire incident at the GRIDCo Akosombo Switchyard, the engineers came up with a temporary solution, which is currently allowing the Akosombo plant to continue supplying power while engineers worked on a permanent solution. results.title: Walmart shares fall as comparable sales growth slows
results.description: Walmart reported sales grew at their slowest pace in the retailer's latest fiscal quarter in six years, sending its shares down more than 9%.
